candidate.user_input: What steps should I take if my bereavement leave needs to be extended beyond 25 calendar days?
candidate.reference: If your bereavement leave exceeds 25 calendar days, you should reach out to your manager, People Business Partner, and the Absence Management Team at leaves@gitlab.com for an extension.
reference_contexts:
### Leave Extensions

### Leave Extensions

If your bereavement leave exceeds 25 calendar days, please reach out to your manager, People Business Partner, and the Absence Management Team at leaves@gitlab.com for an extension.
